newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks seen opening mixed to lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks seen opening mixed to lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open mixed to lower on Tuesday on a day that will be dominated by economic data and earnings reports.

The December consumer price index and retail sales are due ahead of the opening bell while Bay Networks Inc and The Federal National Mortgage Association, or Fannie Mae, are expected to report earnings.
But the most eagerly awaited earnings report is expected from Intel Corp after the close of trading.
